listen_address.description: IP address the server binds to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost-only, 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

document_root.description: Absolute path to the directory served as the web root.

directory_listing.description: If true, automatically generate directory indexes when no index file is found.

ssl_enabled.description: If true, enable HTTPS using the configured certificate and key.

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL/TLS certificate file (only used if SSL is enabled).

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL/TLS private key file (only used if SSL is enabled).

index_files.description: Ordered list of filenames to look for as default index files in a directory.

mime_types.description: Custom MIME type mappings (extension → MIME type). Leave empty to use built-in defaults.

log_file.description: Path to the access log file. Set to empty string '' to disable logging.

run_as_user.description: System user to drop privileges to after binding to port. Use empty string '' to run as root (not recommended).

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a client request before closing the connection.
